name: @datacenter-tycoon/game-logic
description: Core game logic for Datacenter Tycoon — entities, simulation, economy, contracts.

scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p coverage && c8 --report-dir=coverage --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary --all --include=src/**/*.ts --exclude='src/**/*.test.ts' node --test --import tsx --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=coverage/junit.xml $(find src -type f -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
